title: Semilinear Frobenius cube identities for direct images and exchanges
statement:
Fix primes $p\ne\ell$, $a\geq1$, $q=p^a$, $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, an algebraic closure $k$ of $k_0$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside a fixed $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, and $\Lambda\in\{E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\}$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. For every finite-type $k_0$-scheme $W_0$ occurring below put $W=W_0\times_{k_0}k$, $g_W=\operatorname{id}_{W_0}\times\operatorname{Spec}(\operatorname{Frob}_q)$ with geometric Frobenius, and $P_W=Lg_W^*$ [def-weil-frobenius-detailed, def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Use the rational/common-stage bounded constructible categories and Weil pairs $(K,\theta_K:P_WK\xrightarrow{\sim}K)$, with morphisms $u\theta_K=\theta_LP_W(u)$ [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. Give the underlying operations their standard lifts: $H(K,\theta)=(HK,H(\theta)c_{H,K})$, where $c_H:P_{\rm out}H\xrightarrow{\sim}HP_{\rm in}$ is the canonical Frobenius comparison; tensor has structure $(\theta_M\otimes\theta_N)\mu_g$, and internal Hom has structure $R\mathcal Hom(\theta_M^{-1},\theta_N)h_g$. All assertions are restricted to full domains closed under the displayed composites where these operations and comparisons have the stated constructible typing. Retain all underlying finite-Tor, lattice-presentation and witnessed-origin restrictions. No separatedness of the structural morphisms $W_0\to\operatorname{Spec}k_0$ is imposed.

Consider either composable separated finite-type $k_0$-morphisms $X_0\xrightarrow{f_0}Y_0\xrightarrow{h_0}Z_0$, or a Cartesian square of finite-type $k_0$-schemes with separated finite-type arrows $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$, $f'_0:X'_0\to Y'_0$, $u_0:X'_0\to X_0$, $v_0:Y'_0\to Y_0$, with $f_0u_0=v_0f'_0$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. For the square put $U=Lu^*$, $V=Lv^*$, and for either operation $A_r=Rr_*$ or $A_r=Rr_!$ let
$$d=\operatorname{Ex}:VA_f\longrightarrow A_{f'}U$$
be the canonical transformation of [def-exchange-projection], with the specified composition comparisons and coefficient domains of [fix-lem-exchanges]. Give $VA_f$ and $A_{f'}U$ their iterated Frobenius comparisons $c_{VA_f}$ and $c_{A_{f'}U}$, using pullback composition and the exchanges for the Frobenius squares. Then
$$d_{P_XK}c_{VA_f,K}=c_{A_{f'}U,K}P_{Y'}(d_K).$$
For a composition comparison $t:A_hA_f\xrightarrow{\sim}A_{hf}$ the corresponding identity is
$$t_{P_XK}c_{A_hA_f,K}=c_{A_{hf},K}P_Z(t_K).$$
Both $d$ and $t$ consequently induce morphisms of Weil pairs. The compact-support identities commute with the canonical changes between compactification representatives: if $r:A_f^c\xrightarrow{\sim}A_f^{c'}$ is a refinement comparison, then $r_{P_XK}c_{A_f^c,K}=c_{A_f^{c'},K}P_Y(r_K)$, and the exchange and composition identities are intertwined by these comparisons.

These assertions apply to the actual semilinear Frobenius diagrams. At the source layer of each Frobenius face replace the structural map $a_W:W\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ by $a_Wg_W$. The relabeled schemes are finite type over $k$, every Frobenius face becomes $k$-linear, and the underlying sites, constant coefficients and operation transformations agree with the original ones. This identification applies to all composition diagrams, exchange cubes and their base-changed compactifications, without requiring the original schemes to be separated over $k$. The identities above hold after rationalization and common-stage passage on precisely the supplied domains.

proof.text: Use the prerequisite comparison interface, unchanged, recorded by [def-pod-semilinear-exchange-cube-data]. The already proved relabeling lemma remains there; no operation data is chosen anew.
For each of the rational and common coefficient stages, apply its ordinary, support and refinement cube component lemmas. These are only the first components of the five Equivariant clauses.

For any cube c_F(K) α(PK)=Q(α(K)) c_G(K), naturality of α at the arbitrary Weil isomorphism θ:PK≅K gives (c_F F(θ)) α(K)=Q(α(K))(c_G G(θ)). This proves the second Equivariant component with no lattice assumption.

Equivariant transformations compose and remain equivariant after left or right whiskering with a normalized comparison; expand iterated and apply functoriality and naturality. Apply these facts to refinement comparisons for the equivariant parts of representative-change clauses 6 and 7.

Expand changedExchange. The comparison_trans identity collapses the two comparisons on each endpoint, proving clause 6. For clause 7, apply composition_comparison, take inverse compositors, and cancel the composition isomorphisms; transport the compactification only across fiberModels.map_comp. These are equalities in the given stage, independent of any Frobenius choices. Assemble all seven conjunctions at both coefficient stages.

Read the item, its 8 steps and every cited statement in full. Shape: one commit on base 7d752da (item JSON plus report). Live still has the item unsplit, so it is not superseded. The statement and stmt_deps are byte-identical to live. There are no new nodes and no repair note. The proof_deps closure does not contain the item, so the graph is acyclic. No SGA is cited. Route: this is exactly main-20261015 prop-weil-operations proof sentence 1 → lem-fix-weil-operations ('Composition and exchange use the pasting identities of [fix-lem-exchanges]'). The declared tool_uses (fix-lem-exchanges, lem-weil-frobenius-square-cartesian and generic definitions) are accepted. Step 1: I checked a_W∘g_W linearity, (a_t g_t)r = a_s g_s via r g = g r, and finite type under twisting by σ(k)=k. Step 2: the pro-étale site, constant sheaves and the Ex composite of def-exchange-projection depend only on the underlying schemes, so fix-lem-exchanges applies to the relabeled squares. Step 3: I re-derived the cube identity from the horizontal pasting of fix-lem-exchanges clause (2) along the two factorizations g_Y v = v g_{Y'}. This gives d_{P_X}(Vc_f)(c_V A_f) = (A_{f'}c_U)(c_{f'}U)P_{Y'}(d). The typing and layers are consistent, and invertibility of d is not used. Step 4: the vertical pasting of clause (2) gives c_{hf}P_Z(t) = t A_h(c_f) c_h A_f, with the factors in the correct order. Step 5: the base-changed compactification along g_Y is relabeled through p'. Properness is relative to Y and no Frobenius descent of X̄ is assumed. Step 6: clause (4) gives the refinement identity, and the inserted r and r⁻¹ cancel. Step 7: the Weil-morphism equation follows from naturality of α at θ_K, matching def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex. Step 8: the field-stage clauses of fix-lem-exchanges plus the cocycle data of def-exchange-projection. Edge cases: identity u, v; the empty scheme; Spec k_0; a non-separated structural map (the doubled-origin line) — none of them needs structural separatedness. Duplicates: lem-pur-weil-basechange-semilinear-pasting is a special case (Rf_! only, separated k_0-schemes), not a restatement. Maintainer note: it could later cite this item. lem-pur-weil-semilinear-exchange-reindexing and lem-pod-semilinear-field-operation-lifts state different things.
